subject.title: feat: heading-aware chunking + entity extraction for memory search

question: Should OpenClaw make heading-aware chunking part of the builtin memory index now, and should the entity-extraction portion remain in this issue or move to the broader Memory MVP/wiki design track?
rationale: The narrow chunking fix changes persisted index semantics, while entity extraction overlaps separate memory product and plugin-boundary work that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Split And Narrow
options.body: Approve a focused heading-aware chunking design first and move entity extraction to the Memory MVP/wiki design track.

options.title: Keep Combined Design
options.body: Leave this issue as the umbrella memory-search quality track until maintainers settle both chunking and entity extraction together.

options.title: Route To Plugin Boundary
options.body: Ask for this to be implemented through a memory plugin or ClawHub package unless a core memory API gap is identified.

recommendation.title: Split And Narrow
recommendation.body: Approve a focused heading-aware chunking design first and move entity extraction to the Memory MVP/wiki design track.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is closest to the Memory Wiki and memory product boundary work Vincent Koc recently carried.
